title: FlowProblem
description: A problem of a flow, in the details of the errors flow_invalid and flow_draft_invalid.

code.description: Kind of the problem, such as unknown_stage. The list is open: a client shows an unknown kind by its message.

file.description: Path of the file inside the flow, with forward slashes, such as scenarios/bug.yaml; absent when the problem is of the whole flow or of a subagent of the library.

line.description: Line of the file, from 1; absent when unknown.

message.description: The problem, in the operator's language. It names the object, such as a scenario, a node, a stage or a subagent, and not the file.
